svg.title: One run, one trace: duration AND cost on every bar
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One run, one trace: duration AND cost on every bar” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn distributed-trace waterfall inside a dashed box labelled trace_id. The root span agent.run incident.triage spans the full width at 34.1 seconds and $0.176. Five node spans nest inside it - triage 1.9 s $0.008, gather 11.4 s $0.031, diagnose 8.2 s $0.094, propose 6.1 s $0.039 and verify 5.9 s $0.004 - and three tool spans start together under gather, of which tool.read_runbook at 11.2 seconds is drawn much longer and marked in red as why gather is slow. A model-call span under diagnose carries 24,500 input and 1,920 output tokens, a running cost total ticks down the right edge to $0.176, and a print statement is struck through as unable to say what it was nested inside.
